'''Imperial Interdicted Space''' was a security zone in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] that surrounded the [[Derilyn system/Legends|Derilyn]] and [[Berea system/Legends|Berea systems]], and stretched towards the [[Torina system/Legends|Torina system]]. The area was granted its name after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] was placed under martial law by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the area was regularly patrolled by Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Access to Imperial Interdicted Space was restricted and civilian vessels were permitted to pass through the zone only if they had been granted a [[Derilyn Travel Waiver]] by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].
